verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say it reviews the full codebase rather than just the diff (qodo-docs-22). They claim it catches breaking changes and design deviations that diff-only tools miss (qodo-docs-60) and maps how repositories and services connect to show system-wide impact (qodo-docs-14). Existing conventions are covered by a centralized rule system, rules mined from PR history, and learning from past team review activity (qodo-docs-12, qodo-docs-13, qodo-docs-48). missing for 10: explicit documentation of call-site/caller analysis in review findings (the 'full codebase' claim is stated for the PR summary rather than per-finding comments), no independent or hands-on corroboration that review comments actually use repo-wide context.
